# html DOM-string snapshot round-trip. Browser-side capture serialises
# document.documentElement.outerHTML as text/html. Golden at
# <fixture>.snapshots/initial.html.

[!chromium] skip 'html tests drive a real Chromium'

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
exists app.sngl.snapshots/initial.html

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=
sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:std"

output { none { html } }

component main {
    var name = "world"
    text(value=name)
}

func testInitial(t Test, c main) {
    t.snapshot("initial")
}
